screenLevelIssues.explanation: Major design mismatch: The simulator shows a simple list item for 'Net Banking' (with 'Set it up' text), whereas the Figma design specifies a fully detailed 'Net Banking Card' component (270x400px). The card should feature a dark background (#202020) with pattern overlay, ICICI branding, account details ('ICICI a/c - xxx23'), and a distinct bottom bar for 'NET BANKING'. The current implementation is missing this entire card state.

feedback.explanation: The current implementation renders a simple list row, but the design requires a detailed 'Net Banking Card' (270x400px). This consolidated fix implements the full card structure, resolving the missing UI state and the 14 structural position issues (logos, account details, vectors) identified in the analysis.
feedback.fixedCode:
<View style={{ width: 270, height: 400, borderRadius: 12, backgroundColor: '#202020', overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  {/* Main Content Area */}
  <View style={{ flex: 1, padding: 24, position: 'relative' }}>
    {/* Background Pattern Vectors (Absolute) */}
    <View style={{ position: 'absolute', left: -218, top: -125, opacity: 0.5 }}>
      {/* Placeholder for Vector 57/58 */}
      <View style={{ width: 400, height: 400, borderRadius: 200, borderWidth: 1, borderColor: '#333' }} />
    </View>

    {/* Bank Logos */}
    <View style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 24, left: 24, flexDirection: 'row' }}>
      {/* Placeholder for Bank Logos (Small) */}
      <View style={{ width: 32, height: 32, backgroundColor: '#FFF', borderRadius: 16 }} />
    </View>

    {/* Account Details */}
    <View style={{ marginTop: 120 }}>
      <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 20, fontFamily: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', letterSpacing: 2 }}>•••• 2341</Text>
      <View style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <Text style={{ color: '#878787', fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', fontWeight: '600' }}>EXPIRY 06/26</Text>
        <Text style={{ color: '#BABABA', fontSize: 14, fontFamily: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', marginTop: 4 }}>ICICI a/c - xxx23</Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  </View>

  {/* Bottom Bar */}
  <View style={{ height: 64, backgroundColor: '#1A1A1A', flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', paddingHorizontal: 24 }}>
    <Text style={{ color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: 14, fontFamily: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', fontWeight: '600', letterSpacing: 0.5 }}>NET BANKING</Text>
    {/* Edit Icon Placeholder */}
    <View style={{ width: 20, height: 20, borderColor: '#FFF', borderWidth: 1, borderRadius: 4 }} />
  </View>
</View>
